name: Requirements to Implementation Plan
description: Turn a feature request into a plan you can build from: what must be true when it's done, the open questions, the design, small ordered steps each with its test, and the risks.
abilities: Restates the goal and writes acceptance criteria you can check
Asks only the questions that change the design
Breaks the work into small steps in a safe order, each with how to test it
Names the risks, what is out of scope, and a rough size
permissions: Works from what you describe; reads your code in the workspace when there is some
